value.rationale: The focal source identifies (P) as the obstacle to transferring its negative-doubling entropy staircase to general decreasing Lorenz maps and verifies it only by a family-specific expansion argument. The finding replaces that opaque parameter-map null-set assumption by a standard dynamical hypothesis and applies simultaneously to every strict fixed left endpoint. This is structurally useful because it separates the metric input (an equivalent ergodic invariant measure) from the symbolic transfer theorem, while not claiming a general existence result for such measures.
